title: ESG & Sustainability Website
challenge: Create a user-friendly, visually engaging website that effectively communicates ESG Matrix's value proposition and offerings to a diverse audience, including a News/Blog section. Simplify the complex landscape of ESG and Sustainability and address the common pain points encountered.
technologies: Astro.js, Tailwind CSS, Typescript, Astro content collections (.mdx), Git, GitHub, SEO, Vercel

bullets: Promotes their value proposition and offerings effectively to a wide audience
Strategically placed CTAs encourage enquiries and engagement
Clearly outlines their ESG & Sustainability services and solutions
News section shares insights and enhances thought leadership in the industry
Increased traffic and lead generation with SEO optimisations and sharing News posts on LinkedIn

solutions.title: New Website and Blog
solutions.problem: The ESG and Sustainability landscape is complex with a wide scope across industries. ESG Matrix needed a website that effectively communicates their value proposition and offerings.
solutions.solution: Client needs a clear, engaging website that communicates ESG and Sustainability concepts simply and highlights their services effectively. Include a News/Blog section to share insights and thought leadership in ESG and Sustainability.
solutionbullets: Website needs to communicate the client's value proposition and offerings, simply and clearly, to a wide audience
Content needs to be clear and engaging to attract and retain visitors
CTAs should be strategically placed to encourage enquiries and engagement
News/Blog section needs to provides valuable insights and thought leadership in ESG and Sustainability, attracting a wider audience and establishing ESG Matrix as a trusted resource in the industry
impactbullets: Content-rich website attracts and retains visitors
SEO Optimisations boosted traffic and visibility
News articles increased traffic, engagement and time spent on site and helped with lead generation via LinkedIn posts
Clear communication of ESG concepts and solutions has lead to increased enquiries and client engagement
